title: Convert Shooting Crate To Dsl Derive Engine
description: Convert shooting/rs/lib.rs (package `shooting`) from its hand-rolled `mod shooting_text` parser/printer plus manual `impl vcs::DocumentDsl for ShootingFixture`/`impl vcs::OpText for ShootingOperation` onto the declarative `dsl::` derive engine (DslRecord/DslDocument/DslEnum/DslOps), following the established conversion cheat sheet (worked examples: fem/2d, fem/3d, norm/core, imperative/core). shooting/plugin/rs (package `shooting-plugin`) depends on shooting's public types (ShootingFixture/ShootingOperation/ShootingAsset/etc.) but has no DSL impl of its own — must keep compiling/passing against whatever public field/type names result (no renames to existing Rust field names/types). Regenerate shooting/example/base-icon.shooting via the mandatory fixture-regeneration procedure (old parser -> new printer -> write back -> reparse -> assert equality) before deleting the old hand-rolled module. Verify with `cargo test -p shooting -p shooting-plugin` and report exact pass/fail counts.
